description: Integration module to wire snow_connector.py (built 2026-04-16) into approval_workflow. snow_connector.py handles ServiceNow inbound webhook. Integration module must: (1) call ws_query to fetch pending MCP submissions awaiting SNOW resolution, (2) call ws_write to update approval_workflow state when SNOW ticket transitions, (3) include audit_log insert for each state transition. Uses write_service on :8772. Does NOT introduce HTTP between daemons — all communication via write_service API.
